name: JARVIS electric-field-gradient tensor release
description: Computed site-resolved electric-field-gradient tensors with periodic atomic geometries for a JARVIS-DFT material subset.
count_display: 15,202 unique-JID JSON records; publication states 15,187 materials
count_scope: Independently counted v2 JSON payload, with one unique JARVIS identifier per row; publication/repository abstract count is retained as a separate discrepant cohort counter.

sources.title: Primary EFG data descriptor
sources.evidence: Reports EFG calculations for 15,187 JARVIS-DFT materials and a JSON file containing atoms plus raw/diagonalized tensors; uses calculated structures rather than experimental geometries.

sources.title: Figshare v2 release metadata
sources.evidence: Lists JARVIS-EFG4.csv, JARVIS-EFG4.json and parser example, with CC BY 4.0 rights. Downloaded JSON is 18,600,334 bytes; MD5 5877c7410a76e412a695925eb5b4cd27 matches provider metadata and contains 15,202 distinct JIDs.

caveats: Versioned downloadable JSON has 15,202 unique-JID rows, while both article and repository abstract state 15,187; the reason for this difference is unresolved.
This property subset overlaps JARVIS-DFT; it is not 15,202 additional newly discovered compounds.
EFGs are computed on DFT-relaxed geometries; experimental NQR frequency comparison additionally depends on nuclear quadrupole moments and measurement conditions.
Site tensors and materials are different counting units.

additional_counts.scope: Original primary-paper and repository-abstract count; differs from inspected v2 payload

name: AdsZeo equilibrium methane adsorption configurations
description: Coordinate-resolved GCMC adsorption configurations for methane and mobile sodium ions in aluminium-substituted zeolite frameworks.
version: Zenodo 21445386 v1; October 2026 accepted Scientific Data descriptor
count_display: 4,775 framework realizations from 191 topologies; 12,415,000 production frames
count_scope: 25 Al/Na-substituted realizations per parent topology, each sampled at 13 methane pressures between 0.1 and 100 bar at 298 K.

sources.title: Accepted Scientific Data descriptor
sources.evidence: Reports 4,775 realizations from 191 topologies, 62,075 simulations, 12,415,000 saved production frames and 1,245,376,215 particle-coordinate records; accepted version published 8 October 2026.

sources.title: AdsZeo public deposit metadata
sources.evidence: Confirms framework/particle/scalar data in DuckDB, a 12,443,463,680-byte AdsZeo_data.duckdb payload and analysis notebook, with CC BY 4.0 data licence.

caveats: Framework realizations, parent topologies, Monte Carlo runs, saved frames and particle-coordinate rows are distinct counters and must not be summed as materials.
Methane is stored as pseudo-atoms; this is not a full explicit-hydrogen methane coordinate dataset.
Configurations are classical GCMC samples, not DFT-labelled energies/forces or experimentally measured adsorption structures.
The 12.4 GB payload was not downloaded or independently recounted; dataset sizes are primary descriptor/deposit declarations.
The publisher page is an accepted early version and may later be replaced by the Version of Record.

additional_counts.scope: Particle rows within saved frames, not structures

name: Graphene/black-phosphorus ARPES simulation and HOPG reference data
description: Finite-cluster ARPES simulations, Gaussian geometries and direct experimental highly oriented pyrolytic graphite photoemission data.
count_display: Simulation and experimental spectral record count not verified
count_scope: Finite PAH/black-phosphorus simulation sets and experimental HOPG ARPES spectra; deposit packages are not treated as material counts.

sources.title: Primary ARPES data descriptor
sources.evidence: Data Record explicitly includes generated Gaussian/IAC simulation data and experimental HOPG ARPES tables; simulated PAHs span 24–864 carbon atoms, with 11 subfiles per molecular simulation set.

sources.title: Dryad release and rights
sources.evidence: Dataset metadata identifies CC0 1.0. File inventory includes Dataset.zip, experimental ARPES data.zip, PES_program.zip and a program README; file count is not used as a material counter.

caveats: Simulation structures are finite molecules/clusters representing graphene/BP nanostructures, not periodic 2D crystal coordinates.
Direct experimental bulk HOPG spectra make this a mixed materials-spectroscopy resource; filter out finite-model data for strictly periodic benchmarks.
Simulated occupied energies are scaled/shifted against experiment or HOMO/LUMO midpoint; they are not unadjusted periodic DFT band structures.
Payload size/metadata verified; simulation and measured-spectrum counts were not independently enumerated.
